description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Enum' for creating enumeration types in PHP, including methods for handling enum values, keys, serialization, and comparison.

classes.name: Enum
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for enum types in PHP, supporting value retrieval, key access, validation, serialization, and comparison.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an enum instance with a value, converting from another enum if necessary.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Handles deserialization, restoring the key property if missing.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an enum instance from a given value.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the enum's value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another variable is equal to this enum instance.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all constant names defined in the enum class.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns all enum instances for the class constants.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array of constant names and their values.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a value is a valid enum value.

methods.name: assertValidValue
methods.description: Asserts that a value is a valid enum value.

methods.name: assertValidValueReturningKey
methods.description: Returns the key for a valid value or throws an exception.

methods.name: isValidKey
methods.description: Checks if a key is a valid enum key.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns the key for a given value.

methods.name: __callStatic
methods.description: Allows static calls to enum constants to instantiate enum instances.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Prepares the enum instance for JSON serialization.
